paragraphs: Carbyne builds and supports Axon 911 Core, a cloud-native infrastructure layer deployed in agencies across the United States and internationally. Its call-handling product, APEX, pulls call management capabilities into a single user interface for telecommunicators.

Patented live video lets responders see through the eyes of a caller. Location tools pinpoint a caller and track movement as permitted. AI-powered translation arrives directly on the call taker's screen. During call surges, an AI triage tool sorts through calls to identify redundant bystander and onlooker reports, freeing call takers for other emergencies. A continuity option has the AT&T Resolution Center redirect 911 calls and texts to devices running APEX Continuity. That reroute is triggered manually by the center rather than automatically.

The company states 99.999% call-handling uptime in the cloud. It describes the platform as providing the security of AWS GovCloud. Carbyne counts more than 100 partners and over 40 integrations on its open platform. The site names Orleans Parish Communication District as a center using its Emergency Call Triage.

quote.text: Rely on 99.999% call-handling uptime in the cloud
